name: API brain
description: Our own agent loop over APIs: Anthropic (Messages API), OpenAI, OpenRouter and any OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM). Brain refs: api:anthropic, api:openai, api:openrouter, api:custom. Model requests go through the brain session's network proxy: to use a server on your local network, add its host to the "brainEgressAllow" hub setting (localhost is always reachable).
